marker: Loopback-only validation of the same-host graft post-send control plane (capability + cert/trust contract shape). This is NOT reciprocal HTTPS/mTLS peer-trust proof between two physical hosts.

validated_contracts.name: loopback_capability_authenticated_transport
validated_contracts.meaning: The graft post-send channel binds 127.0.0.1:0, publishes an owner-only endpoint record, and authenticates each connection with a per-bind 32-byte LocalCapability token. A forged capability is rejected. Non-loopback peers are dropped without being served.

validated_contracts.name: graft_receiver_runtime_and_faker_parity
validated_contracts.meaning: The receiver loop delivers capability-authenticated nudges over loopback TCP and returns typed errors, with no interprocess::local_socket / named-pipe backend on any platform.

certificate_trust_contract_reference.note: Reciprocal HTTPS interfaces, certificate fingerprints, and exact trusted-peer records are exercised by `atm doctor` peer_config and the peer-pair runner on two physical hosts. See artifacts/phase-ai/ai14/doctor-after-local-http.json for the single-host loopback peer_config shape (certificate_fingerprint present, trusted_peer_count 0).

meaning: The local loopback control plane and its authentication gate are proven on this host. Reciprocal two-host certificate/trust validation is release-operator work that requires a real macOS host and a real Windows host and remains open.
